summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of an interest on capital (IoC) distribution, a Brazilian equivalent of a dividend. The gross amount is R$350,000,000 (R$288,750,000 net of 17.5% withholding tax), with a gross per-share value of R$0.10952537999. The record date is August 26, 2026, after which shares trade ex-IoC. The net amount will be allocated to the mandatory minimum dividend for fiscal year 2026, with payment by April 30, 2027. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, not a special-situation event; the per-share value may adjust due to the active share buyback program.
